# meshstack_user (Data Source)

Read the one meshUser that matches what you set in `metadata` and `spec`, such as `spec.email`. Set at least one of `metadata.name`, `metadata.uuid`, `spec.email` and `spec.euid`. It fails unless exactly one user matches, so you can use it to check that a user exists. Deleted users are not found.

~> Needs an API key with the admin permission `ADM_USER_LIST`. meshStack has no workspace-scoped permission to read users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meshstack_user" "example" {
  spec = {
    email = "jane.doe@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `metadata` (Attributes) Identifiers of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) Profile of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Read-Only

- `ref` (Attributes) Reference to this user, can be used as `user_ref` in `meshstack_workspace_user_group_member`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ref))
- `status` (Attributes) Information meshStack keeps about the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Username of the user. A workspace user group lists its members by it, and a user binding names the user by it in `subject.name`. Set it to narrow the lookup.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the user. Set it to narrow the lookup.


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Optional:

- `email` (String) Email address of the user. Set it to narrow the lookup.
- `euid` (String) External user ID, which meshStack uses to find the user in the cloud platforms. Set it to narrow the lookup.

Read-Only:

- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `tags` (Map of List of String) Tags of `meshUser`.


<a id="nestedatt--ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshUser`.
- `name` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of `meshUser`.


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `last_login` (String) When the user last signed in to meshPanel. Null for a user who has never signed in.
- `lifecycle` (Attributes) Lifecycle of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--lifecycle))

<a id="nestedatt--status--lifecycle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.lifecycle`

Read-Only:

- `state` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `DEACTIVATED` for a user your identity provider has deactivated.
